nodes.text:
🦠 Thread: Understanding Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) 🦠
What is HMPV? 
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that causes symptoms similar to the common cold. It can lead to more severe respiratory infections, especially in young children, older adults, 
#HMPV

nodes.author: NaveenkSakinala
nodes.text:
and people with weakened immune systems
🤧 Symptoms of HMPV Common symptoms include:
Cough
Fever
Runny or stuffy nose
Sore throat
Wheezing
Shortness of breath
#HMPV #Health #VirusAwareness

nodes.author: NaveenkSakinala
nodes.text:
🏥 Who is at Risk? 
While most cases are mild, young children, adults over 65, and those with weakened immune systems are at higher risk for severe illness
#HMPV #Health #VirusAwareness

nodes.author: NaveenkSakinala
nodes.text:
🌍 How Does HMPV Spread? 
HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets from coughing and sneezing, close personal contact, and touching contaminated surfaces
#HMPV #Health #VirusAwareness

nodes.author: NaveenkSakinala
nodes.text:
🛡️ Prevention Tips

Wash hands frequently with soap and water
Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands
Stay away from sick individuals
Clean and disinfect frequently touched surfaces
#HMPV #Health #VirusAwareness

nodes.author: NaveenkSakinala
nodes.text:
🩺 Treatment There is no specific treatment for HMPV. Most people recover with rest, fluids, and over-the-counter medications to relieve symptoms
📅 Seasonality HMPV infections are more common in late winter and spring

Stay informed and take care!💪 #HMPV #Health #VirusAwareness
